## 4. What NOT to change (intentional)

| Pattern | Why keep it |
|---------|-------------|
| `harness\autonomy\` inside core tree | Source for `--autonomy` install; disabled by default via policy + install flag (`harness\autonomy\README.md`, ADR-009) |
| `midas-autopilot.mjs` CLI name | Explicitly unchanged in `harness\migrations\v2.8.2.md` |
| Deprecated stub skills `midas-autopilot`, `midas-improve-loop` | Migration contract; redirect skills with `disable-model-invocation: true` |
| `layout: classic` in `harness\state.yaml` | Engine dogfood design (`paths.engine: harness`, `paths.runs: .harness`) |
| Dual `pipeline/` + `skills/` layers | Pipeline = orchestrator playbook; skill = user-typed slash command |
| `checks.json` / `gates.json` as generated artifacts | Consumed by doctor/bundle; source is `rules/` + `methodology.md` |
| `harness\skill-registry.md` GENERATED header | Correct â€” edit via `scripts/skill-registry.mjs` |
| `stage-command-table.yaml` omitting auxiliary skills | By design â€” only 9-phase PC; aux commands in `docs/skills.md` |
| `midas-precommit` in harness skills | Engine-only guard (`harness\skills\midas-precommit\SKILL.md` aborts on installs) |
| `execute-next-sprint-task.md` + `.json` in autonomy | Human-readable contract + machine schema â€” not duplication |
| `pilot.md` referencing `examples/taskpilot/` | P0 pilot protocol, not install layout |
